about: Highest Vulkan version each GPU vendor's own drivers support, matched against the GPU names e2a reads (macOS: system_profiler SPDisplaysDataType; CUDA: nvidia-smi; else the Vulkan loader's device names), with (R) / (TM) removed. A GPU at null gets no Vulkan package on any OS. On macOS, where MoltenVK advertises its latest Vulkan for any GPU, MoltenVK is also capped to this version (MVK_CONFIG_API_VERSION_TO_ADVERTISE); elsewhere the GPU's own driver reports its version. Whatever the table says, a hidden test synthesis on the GPU decides (zonos.py) and its verdict is kept per package and GPU.

sources.Intel: https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/support/articles/000005524/graphics.html (Supported APIs for Intel Graphics, last reviewed 10/23/2025): Intel Core processors and discrete tables
sources.AMD: AMD Windows driver levels for the GPU families Apple shipped in Intel Macs (GCN 1-3 on legacy drivers, GCN 4/Vega/RDNA on current ones); not from an AMD table, the hidden test decides
sources.NVIDIA: NVIDIA R470 legacy driver level for the Kepler GPUs Apple shipped (2012-2014 Macs); not from an NVIDIA table, the hidden test decides
